units.source_text: 彼此客气寒暄一番后，老板取出包在纸里的钱。

en.t: After they had exchanged polite greetings, the owner took out the money wrapped in paper.

units.source_text: 可能是定好了那天付定金吧。

en.t: It was probably arranged that he would pay the deposit that day.

units.source_text: 父亲将手放在火炉上面取暖，静静的鞠了一躬以示谢意。

en.t: Father warmed his hands over the brazier and quietly bowed to show his thanks.

units.source_text: 这时，母亲安排我端茶进去。

en.t: At that point, Mother told me to carry in the tea.

units.source_text: 正在我奉茶的时候，丸佐老板突然高声说：“不行，不行，这不行。”

en.t: As I was serving the tea, the owner of Marusa suddenly said loudly, "No, no, this will not do."

units.source_text: 我以为是说我奉茶不行，怔怔的杵在一旁，原来是老板面前有另一包钱。

en.t: I thought he meant there was something wrong with the way I served the tea and stood there dumbfounded, but in fact there was another packet of money in front of the owner.
